children: Shares of Australia's Corporate Travel Management
plunged on Thursday to their lowest in nearly 14 years after trading resumed following a suspension of more than a year over a missed deadline for financial results.
The business travel management services provider's shares fell as much as 82.5% to A$2.81 by 0007 GMT, hitting their lowest since October 10, 2012, and heading for their worst session ever.
The stock resumed trading after being suspended from trading on the ASX since August 22, 2025.
